# AC Server Manager 0.5.0 Preview

## Changes

- Compact search fields with blue focus borders and aligned input/placeholder text in the catalog and creation wizard.
- Choose and remember your own server folder without an assumed location. Detect Assetto Corsa through Steam libraries and its app manifest, with manual folder selection available.
- Delete stopped local servers through the Windows Recycle Bin, with a folder-specific confirmation and checks for running processes, game paths, nested servers and linked/network directories.
- Double-click a car name in **Cars and slots** to open a single-car reference dialog with description, available specifications, skin icons and preview. Applying a skin changes only the selected slot's draft; Cancel preserves it.
- Read older Kunos car/skin/track metadata in Western Windows-1252 and Unicode BOM encodings without changing game files.

## Download and run

Extract **ACServerManager-0.5.0-preview-win-x64.zip** completely into a writable folder and run **AssettoServerManager.exe**. The Windows x64 package includes .NET; keep the other files alongside the EXE. `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the archive checksum.

Bring your own Assetto Corsa installation, mods and Content Manager. Servers stay in the folder you choose. AssettoServer is installed separately by the creation wizard. Importing complete server archives into an internal library remains deferred.

The car dialog uses installed skin images, not a 3D showroom. Configuration changes require saving and restarting the server. Application: MIT; bundled runtime notices are in `licenses/`.
